title: Form and Void: Entangled Composition through an Autonomous AI Agent
title_zh: 形式与虚空：通过自主AI智能体实现的纠缠式构图

paragraphs.en: Positive and negative space is a fundamental principle in visual composition, supporting visually coherent forms and layered semantic relationships. Generating such compositions is challenging because it requires coordinated control over two semantic concepts that share a common boundary. Although recent text-to-image models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance in image generation and visual understanding, positive-negative space generation remains difficult, particularly under direct single-pass prompting. In this work, we present the F orm a nd V oid A gent ( FaV-A ), a multimodal agent designed for staged positive-negative space generation. FaV-A follows a progressive workflow: it first generates a base object, then analyzes its shape and spatial structure to identify candidate negative-space semantics, and finally produces compositional instructions for the final image generation stage. Experimental results and ablation analyses suggest that FaV-A provides a more effective framework than direct zero-shot MLLM baselines for producing visually coherent and semantically aligned positive-negative space compositions.
paragraphs.zh: 正负空间是视觉构图的基本原则，它有助于构建视觉上连贯的形式和分层的语义关系。 生成此类构图具有挑战性，因为它需要协调控制两个共享共同边界的语义概念。 尽管近期的文本到图像模型和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在图像生成和视觉理解方面取得了显著成效，但正负空间的生成仍然困难，尤其是在直接单轮提示的情况下。 在本研究中，我们提出了“形式与虚空智能体”（FaV-A），这是一种专为分阶段生成正负空间而设计的多模态智能体。 FaV-A 遵循一个渐进式的工作流程：首先生成基础对象，然后分析其形状和空间结构以识别候选的负空间语义，最后为最终图像生成阶段提供构图指令。 实验结果和消融分析表明，与直接的零样本 MLLM 基线相比，FaV-A 在生成视觉上连贯且语义对齐的正负空间构图方面提供了更有效的框架。

paragraphs.en: The interplay between form and void lies at the core of visual composition and is classically expressed through positive and negative space. In art and design, negative space refers to the empty regions around and between the subjects of an image [ 17 , 16 , 4 ] . This principle plays an important role across visual art, photography [ 2 ] , graphic design [ 14 ] , and sculpture [ 25 ] . Designing with negative space requires careful coordination of visual elements, as figure-ground relationships affect not only compositional structure but also semantic interpretation. From a computational perspective, generating such compositions is challenging because the model must simultaneously represent an explicit foreground form and an implicit secondary shape induced by the surrounding space.
paragraphs.zh: 形式与虚空之间的相互作用是视觉构图的核心，通常通过正负空间来经典呈现。 在艺术与设计领域，负空间指的是图像主体周围及主体之间的空白区域 [ 17 , 16 , 4 ] 。 这一原则在视觉艺术、摄影 [ 2 ] 、平面设计 [ 14 ] 和雕塑 [ 25 ] 中均发挥着重要作用。 运用负空间进行设计需要精心协调视觉元素，因为图底关系不仅影响构图结构，也影响语义解读。 从计算角度来看，生成此类构图具有挑战性，因为模型必须同时表现明确的前景形式以及由周围空间所引发的隐含次级形状。

paragraphs.en: Recent text-to-image models have shown strong capabilities in visual generation. However, existing generation pipelines often rely on explicit spatial controls, such as masks, layouts, or other manually specified conditions, to manage figure-ground relationships. With the emergence of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) [ 19 , 5 , 21 ] , visual understanding has improved substantially. Nevertheless, a gap remains between understanding and generation: although MLLMs can often recognize and describe positive-negative space compositions, generating such effects in a zero-shot, single-pass setting remains difficult. In our preliminary observations, directly prompting an end-to-end model to synthesize two overlapping semantic concepts with a shared boundary often results in structurally unstable compositions or semantically ambiguous outputs. These observations motivate a staged generation framework in which structure discovery and semantic refinement are separated into successive steps.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的文本到图像模型在视觉生成方面展现了强大的能力。 然而，现有的生成流程通常依赖显式的空间控制手段，例如掩码、布局或其他手动指定的条件，来管理图底关系。 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）[ 19 , 5 , 21 ] 的出现，视觉理解能力得到了显著提升。 尽管如此，理解与生成之间仍存在差距：尽管 MLLMs 通常能够识别并描述正负空间构图，但在零样本、单次处理的设置下生成此类效果仍然具有挑战性。 在我们的初步观察中，直接提示端到端模型合成两个具有共享边界的重叠语义概念，往往会导致结构不稳定的构图或语义模糊的输出。 这些观察结果促使我们提出一种分阶段生成框架，将结构发现与语义细化分离为连续的两个步骤。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we adopt a staged generation perspective motivated by common design workflows. In positive-negative space composition, a plausible workflow is to first establish a primary subject, then inspect its contour and spatial structure, and finally refine the image by introducing secondary semantics in the negative space. Following this intuition, we model the task as a sequence of intermediate steps in which earlier outputs provide structural guidance for later stages. This decomposition reduces the burden of requiring a model to resolve shared-boundary geometry and dual semantic alignment in a single generation step. In addition, recent work on MLLM-based agents suggests that explicit intermediate reasoning can be beneficial for complex multimodal generation tasks [ 7 , 8 , 6 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一差距，我们采用了一种分阶段生成的视角，其灵感来源于常见的设计工作流程。 在正负空间构图法中，一种合理的工作流程是：首先确立一个主要主体，然后检查其轮廓和空间结构，最后通过在负空间中引入次要语义来优化图像。 基于这一思路，我们将该任务建模为一系列中间步骤，其中早期的输出为后续阶段提供结构指导。 这种分解降低了模型在一次生成步骤中同时解决共享边界几何结构和双重语义对齐问题的负担。 此外，近期关于基于 MLLM 的智能体的研究指出，明确的中间推理可能对复杂的多模态生成任务有益 [ 7 , 8 , 6 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this perspective, we present the Form and Void Agent (FaV-A), a multimodal agent for positive-negative space generation from abstract topics. Rather than relying on one-shot synthesis, FaV-A adopts a staged workflow. Given a topic, it first generates a base object informed by design-oriented priors. It then analyzes the base image to identify shape and spatial cues that could support a secondary interpretation in the negative space. Finally, these observations are translated into compositional instructions for the final image generation step. As shown in Figure 1 , this staged process yields more coherent positive-negative space compositions in our examples. These results suggest that multimodal agents are a promising direction for design-oriented generation tasks that require coordinated spatial and semantic control.

paragraphs.en: To summarize, this work makes three contributions. First, we formulate positive-negative space generation as a challenging multimodal design problem that requires coordinated spatial and semantic reasoning under shared-boundary constraints. Second, we propose the Form and Void Agent (FaV-A), a staged multimodal agent that decomposes this task into three successive phases: base-object generation, image-aware structural analysis, and instruction-guided final synthesis. Third, through qualitative comparisons, user evaluation, and ablation analysis, we show that this staged framework produces more structurally coherent and semantically aligned positive-negative space compositions than direct zero-shot MLLM prompting.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，这项工作做出了三项贡献。 首先，我们将正负空间生成问题表述为一个具有挑战性的多模态设计问题，该问题要求在共享边界约束下，进行协调的空间与语义推理。 其次，我们提出了“形式与虚空智能体”（Form and Void Agent, FaV-A），这是一种分阶段的多模态智能体，它将此任务分解为三个连续阶段：基础对象生成、图像感知结构分析以及指令引导的最终合成。 第三，通过定性比较、用户评估和消融分析，我们证明了这种分阶段框架生成的正负空间构图，在结构连贯性和语义一致性方面优于直接的零样本 MLLM 提示方法。

paragraphs.en: Recent diffusion-based methods have shown that generative models can produce images with multiple valid interpretations under predefined transformations or viewing setups, such as multi-view optical illusions or physically arranged illusion patterns [ 11 , 3 ] . However, these methods typically target fixed transformation rules or illusion mechanisms, rather than discovering a figure-ground composition from an abstract semantic topic.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的扩散模型方法表明，生成模型能够在预定义的变换或观察设置下生成具有多种有效解释的图像，例如多视角光学错觉或物理排列的错觉图案 [ 11 , 3 ] 。 然而，这些方法通常针对固定的变换规则或错觉机制，而不是从抽象语义主题中探索图底构图。

paragraphs.en: Controllable image generation with explicit structural conditions is also the research focus. Methods such as ControlNet, T2I-Adapter, and GLIGEN enable text-to-image models to follow masks, edges, depth maps, keypoints, bounding boxes, or other grounding signals [ 27 , 18 , 15 ] . These approaches provide strong spatial control once the control signal is available, but they generally assume that the relevant structure has already been specified. In contrast, our setting begins with an abstract topic and requires the system to infer both a suitable primary form and a compatible negative-space interpretation without manually designed spatial templates.
paragraphs.zh: 在明确结构条件下实现可控图像生成也是研究重点。 ControlNet、T2I-Adapter 和 GLIGEN 等方法使文本到图像模型能够遵循掩码、边缘、深度图、关键点、边界框或其他定位信号 [ 27 , 18 , 15 ] 。 一旦控制信号可用，这些方法就能提供强大的空间控制能力，但它们通常假设相关结构已经明确指定。 相比之下，我们的设定从一个抽象主题开始，要求系统在没有手动设计空间模板的情况下，推断出合适的主要形态和兼容的负空间解释。

paragraphs.en: Recent MLLM-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in visually grounded planning and execution [ 13 ] . In creative and design-oriented settings, PosterLLaVA formulates poster layout generation with multimodal large language models, GenArtist uses an MLLM agent to coordinate image generation and editing through planning and verification, and BannerAgency applies multimodal agents to the creation of editable advertising banners [ 26 , 24 , 23 ] . GraphicBench further shows that graphic design remains challenging for language agents, especially when reasoning about spatial relationships and coordinating global dependencies across design decisions [ 12 ] .

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , unlike layout-controlled generation pipelines that depend on manually specified masks, edges, or spatial layouts, FaV-A follows a staged and mask-free generation process. Instead of directly mapping 𝒯 \mathcal{T} to the final image in a single step, the agent decomposes the task into three sequential stages. In Stage I, Topic-Driven Semantic Planning ( ℳ plan \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{plan}} ), the agent converts the input topic into a base-object prompt and a high-level compositional plan, guided by design priors 𝒫 prior \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{prior}} . In Stage II, Multi-Modal Spatial Parsing and In-Context Anchoring ( ℳ parse \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{parse}} ), the agent generates a base image and analyzes its shape and spatial structure to derive constraints for negative-space composition. In Stage III, Mask-Free Entangled Synthesis ( ℳ syn \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{syn}} ), the agent uses the base image and the derived structural cues to produce the final positive-negative space composition.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2 所示，与依赖手动指定掩码、边缘或空间布局的布局控制生成流程不同，FaV-A 遵循一个分阶段且无需掩码的生成过程。 智能体并未将 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 直接通过单一步骤映射到最终图像，而是将该任务分解为三个顺序阶段。 在阶段 I（主题驱动语义规划，ℳ plan \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{plan}}）中，智能体根据设计先验 𝒫 prior \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{prior}} 将输入主题转换为基础对象提示词和高层构图计划。 在阶段 II（多模态空间解析与上下文锚定，ℳ parse \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{parse}}）中，智能体生成一张基础图像，并分析其形状与空间结构，以推导出负空间构图的约束条件。 在阶段 III（无掩码纠缠合成，ℳ syn \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{syn}}）中，智能体利用基础图像和推导出的结构线索，生成最终的正负空间构图。

paragraphs.en: Definition of Positive-Negative Space Art (Form and Void): Positive-negative space refers to a composition where the positive shape (the subject) and the negative space (the area around it) are equally important and interdependent. paragraphs.en: Semantic Drift and Weak Topic Grounding (Claude): Claude exhibits the weakest alignment with the intended topics. paragraphs.en: Topic-Consistent but Additive Composition (Gemini): Gemini generally preserves the target concepts and produces recognizable topic-relevant objects. paragraphs.en: Advantages of the FaV-A Architecture. In contrast, our proposed method successfully achieves structural entanglement by reformulating the visual illusion as a progressive, constrained reasoning task. Rather than expecting an MLLM to perform zero-shot spatial alignment in a single generation step, FaV-A utilizes a base image to establish an initial geometric foundation. By conducting multi-dimensional visual parsing on this base image, the agent synthesizes a precise semantic spatial anchor ( 𝒫 anchor \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{anchor}} ). This anchor explicitly maps the semantic requirements to specific topological regions (e.g., instructing the model to align a facial profile with the jagged external edge of a primary object). Guided by these rigorous spatial constraints, the final synthesis stage aligns the conflicting visual priors, forcing the positive and negative spaces to share a single, continuous contour. This methodology ensures the reliable emergence of bistable perception, realizing the “one shape, dual meaning” principle that direct prompting baselines cannot achieve.
paragraphs.zh: FaV-A 架构的优势。 相比之下，我们提出的方法通过将视觉错觉重新表述为一种渐进式、受约束的推理任务，成功实现了结构纠缠。 FaV-A 并未期望 MLLM 在单次生成步骤中完成零样本空间对齐，而是利用一张基础图像来建立初始的几何基础。 通过对这张基础图像进行多维视觉解析，智能体能够合成一个精确的语义空间锚点（𝒫 anchor \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{anchor}}）。 该锚点将语义要求明确映射到特定的拓扑区域（例如，指示模型将面部侧影与主要物体的锯齿状外部边缘对齐）。 在这些严格的空间约束指导下，最终合成阶段会协调冲突的视觉先验，迫使正负空间共享一条单一、连续的轮廓线。 这种方法确保了双稳态感知的可靠出现，实现了直接提示基线无法达成的“一种形状，双重含义”原则。

paragraphs.en: To rigorously quantify these qualitative observations, we conducted a user study ( N = 50 N=50 ) to evaluate the ablated variants across three dimensions: Topic Adherence (TA), Gestalt Quality (GQ), and overall Aesthetic Score (AS) on a 5-point Likert scale. The participants were recruited from graduate students and researchers with prior experience in visual design, computer vision, or digital art, including a subset with formal design training. During evaluation, all results were anonymized and presented in randomized order, such that the raters were unaware of which method produced each image. Each participant was asked to score the generated artworks independently based on the three criteria, following a unified instruction sheet describing the meaning of each metric. This procedure was adopted to reduce presentation bias and improve the reliability of subjective assessment.

The quantitative results strongly align with our visual findings: notably, the removal of topic analysis causes a severe drop in TA (1.35), reflecting the model’s inability to follow the semantic prompt. paragraphs.en: Topic Analysis. The primary role of this module is to decompose an abstract concept into candidate positive and negative entities and establish their initial spatial relationship. For the ablation, we bypass the semantic planning and feed the raw topic directly to the subsequent stages. The absence of this preliminary logic causes the output to degenerate into a shallow juxtaposition of elements (see Figure 4 (b)). In the “Petting a Cat” example, the design merely stacks a hand silhouette and a cat silhouette vertically, lacking intentional interaction. In contrast, the full pipeline allows the hand to act as a negative shape that wraps around and gently strokes the cat’s head, demonstrating a much stronger figure-ground interplay (see Figure 4 (a)).
paragraphs.zh: 主题分析。 该模块的主要作用是将抽象概念分解为候选的正负实体，并建立它们之间的初始空间关系。 在消融实验中，我们绕过了语义规划，将原始主题直接输入到后续阶段。 缺少这种初步逻辑会导致输出退化为元素的浅层并置（参见图 4 (b)）。 在“抚摸猫咪”的例子中，该设计仅将手的轮廓和猫的轮廓垂直堆叠，缺乏有意图的互动。 相比之下，完整流程允许手作为一个负形，包裹并轻柔地抚摸猫的头，展现出更强的图底互动（参见图 4 (a)）。

paragraphs.en: Base Object Prompt. This module translates the topic into morphological instructions to synthesize a base image capable of supporting negative space carving. For the ablation, we replace the LLM-derived instructions with a generic manual prompt: “Positive or negative shapes representing { topic } ” . As observed in the upper example of Figure 4 (c), this underspecified prompt introduces severe semantic deviation at the source—generating an irrelevant dragonfly-like shape due to an unstable interpretation of the word “player”. This error propagates through the pipeline, proving that precise initial morphological constraints are essential to prevent downstream semantic drift.
paragraphs.zh: 基础对象提示。 该模块将主题转化为形态学指令，以合成一个能够支持负空间雕刻的基础图像。 在消融实验中，我们将由大语言模型生成的指令替换为一个通用手动提示：“代表 { 主题 } 的正形或负形”。 如图 4 (c) 的上例所示，这个定义不足的提示在源头就引入了严重的语义偏差——由于对“player”一词的不稳定解读，生成了一个无关的类似蜻蜓的形状。 这一错误在整个处理流程中不断传递，证明了精确的初始形态学约束对于防止下游语义漂移至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Image Feature Analysis. This stage grounds the spatial reasoning in the actual geometry (e.g., shape characteristics, visual hierarchy) of the generated base image. Consequently, the final outputs suffer from a loss of structural fidelity: in the upper example, the player’s hair characteristics are noticeably altered; in the lower example, the cat’s pose drifts. This analysis is particularly crucial for a human-in-the-loop workflow, where the intermediate base form selected by a designer must remain morphologically stable during final generation.

paragraphs.en: Here we qualitatively evaluate the autonomous compositions generated by our FaV-A (see Figure 5 ). paragraphs.en: Traditional generative models typically struggle to map semantic intent to negative space, often defaulting to generating isolated foreground forms without explicit mask guidance. FaV-A, however, transforms spatial absence into a highly structured semantic entity. In Silent Duel: Between the Pieces and Their Masters (see Figure 5(a) (1)), the negative space surrounding the chess piece is precisely sculpted into a human profile in the latent space. Similarly, in Phantom of Peace: A Doomsday Mushroom Cloud Beneath the Olive Branch (see Figure 5(a) (3)), the mushroom cloud is synthesized entirely through the absence of surrounding textures rather than explicit contours. This demonstrates the agent’s robust semantic-to-spatial entanglement, effectively translating the rich cognitive constraints of the semantic anchor ( 𝒫 anchor \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{anchor}} ) into complex topological boundaries without human-engineered layouts.
paragraphs.zh: 传统的生成模型通常难以将语义意图映射到负空间，往往在没有明确掩码引导的情况下，仅生成孤立的主体形态。 然而，FaV-A 将空间上的缺失转化为一个高度结构化的语义实体。 在《无声对决：棋子与棋手之间》（见图 5(a) (1)）中，围绕棋子的负空间在潜在空间中被精确地塑造成一个人物侧影。 同样，在《和平的幻影：橄榄枝下的末日蘑菇云》（见图 5(a) (3)）中，蘑菇云完全通过周围纹理的缺失而非明确的轮廓合成出来。 这展示了智能体强大的语义-空间纠缠能力，能够有效地将语义锚点（𝒫 anchor \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{anchor}}）丰富的认知约束转化为复杂的拓扑边界，而无需依赖人工设计的布局。

paragraphs.en: A fundamental technical challenge in generating visual illusions is maintaining structural coherence across overlapping visual elements without causing morphological collapse or semantic bleeding. FaV-A overcomes this by enforcing high-frequency edge preservation guided by its internal cross-modal attention mechanisms. In Whispered Kiss Beneath the Rose (see Figure 5(a) (2)), a couple’s interaction subtly emerges from the intrinsic curves of the rose, effectively blending surface geometry and hidden subtext. In Harmonious Gaze: Poetry of Cat and Cat/Dog in Silent Companionship (see Figure 5(b) (Left)), both the primary silhouette and the embedded negative-space figures maintain high visual legibility. This confirms the agent’s capacity to simultaneously optimize two distinct visual priors along a shared, continuous boundary, ensuring dual-semantics within a single structural contour.
paragraphs.zh: 生成视觉幻觉的一项基本技术挑战在于，如何在重叠的视觉元素之间保持结构连贯性，同时避免形态崩溃或语义渗透。 FaV-A 通过其内部跨模态注意力机制引导的高频边缘保留策略克服了这一问题。 在《玫瑰下的低语之吻》（见图 5(a) (2)）中，一对情侣的互动从玫瑰本身的内在曲线中悄然浮现，实现了表面几何形态与隐藏潜台词的有效融合。 在《和谐凝视：猫与猫/犬的静默陪伴之诗》（见图 5(b)（左））中，主要轮廓以及嵌入其中的负空间形象均保持了高度的视觉可读性。 这证实了该智能体能够沿着共享的连续边界同时优化两种不同的视觉先验，从而确保单一结构轮廓内包含双重语义。

sents.en: In Harmonious Gaze: Poetry of Cat and Cat/Dog in Silent Companionship (see Figure 5(b) (Left)), both the primary silhouette and the embedded negative-space figures maintain high visual legibility.

sents.en: This confirms the agent’s capacity to simultaneously optimize two distinct visual priors along a shared, continuous boundary, ensuring dual-semantics within a single structural contour.

paragraphs.en: We further explore the agent’s generalization capabilities in cross-domain scenarios involving typography. In the CAT/DOG typography series (see Figure 5(b) (Right)), text characters and animal silhouettes are fused into bistable configurations that resist immediate deterministic classification. For a standard vision model, textual forms and biological contours typically belong to disparate latent distributions, making seamless integration difficult. Yet, FaV-A successfully navigates this dual constraint: it interprets textual forms as the rigid “ground” while dynamically embedding animal silhouettes into the enclosed negative spaces. This algorithmic emergence of Gestalt perception highlights the MLLM’s advanced compositional reasoning, proving its proficiency in handling conflicting multi-objective spatial tasks.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced Form and Void Agent (FaV-A), a novel autonomous multi-modal system designed to synthesize complex positive-negative space compositions based on abstract textual topics. By formulating visual illusions as a sequence of high-level cognitive reasoning tasks, we bypass the heavy reliance on explicit spatial masks and structural templates prevalent in existing controlled diffusion models. Our proposed three-stage pipeline successfully integrates topic-driven semantic planning, in-context spatial anchoring, and mask-free (I&T) to (I&T) synthesis. Experimental results demonstrate that FaV-A not only executes cross-modal visual alignment with high structural coherence but also exhibits advanced zero-shot topological reasoning capabilities, such as multi-stable perception and cross-domain typographic integration. Ultimately, FaV-A highlights the immense potential of Large Multimodal Models to serve as autonomous cognitive partners in high-level aesthetic design, paving the way for more sophisticated, semantic-driven computational artistry.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了形式与虚空智能体（FaV-A），这是一种新颖的自主多模态系统，旨在基于抽象文本主题合成复杂的正负空间构图。 通过将视觉错觉表述为一系列高级认知推理任务，我们避免了对现有受控扩散模型中常见的显式空间掩码和结构模板的过度依赖。 我们提出的三阶段流程成功整合了主题驱动的语义规划、上下文空间锚定以及无掩码的（I&T）到（I&T）合成。 实验结果表明，FaV-A 不仅以高度结构连贯性执行了跨模态视觉对齐，还展现出先进的零样本拓扑推理能力，例如多稳定感知和跨领域字体集成。 最终，FaV-A 凸显了大型多模态模型作为高级美学设计中的自主认知伙伴的巨大潜力，为更复杂、以语义驱动的计算艺术创作开辟了道路。
